newsitem.title: UK: BFI up 13 as Atlantic Panamaxes firm again.
newsitem.headline: BFI up 13 as Atlantic Panamaxes firm again.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) was up 13 on Thursday at 1,490 points with brokers saying that sharp increases in Atlantic Panamax rates were both rumoured and reported today.

Maricobber was said fixed 52,000 heavy grain USGulf to Japan for Jan 5/15 at $25.00 no combination by Japanese charterers and reports circulated that 54,000 heavy grain was fixed for similar dates by South Korean charterers at $26.00 no combination.

Merchant Pride 69,548 dwt was believed fixed delivery USGulf end Dec trip far east at $15,000 daily plus $300,000 bonus and there were rumours of Panamax timecharter levels to the East in excess of $15,000 daily delivery Continent being circulated.
BIFFEX reflected the prospective strength of rates in the run-up to the Christmas holiday period and values rose between 10 and 25 points and turnover at 1300 GMT totalled 355 lots.
